clue.text: On stage, Bible not at first readable

parts.note: a stage of a journey is a leg

indicators.note: the word Bible loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: A theatrical Bible reading that starts off garbled and only later comes across clearly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not at first' drops the B from BIBLE, leaving IBLE; 'On' simply puts the pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: Handwriting or print that can be read easily is described with this adjective, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Find commanding officer getting in after time

indicators.note: the officer's letters are getting in, that is entering, the word for after time

parts.note: something after the appointed time is late
OC is the military abbreviation for Officer Commanding

explanation.surface: A search for a senior officer who has arrived late.
explanation.walkthrough: The abbreviation is OC (Officer Commanding), not CO; 'getting in' puts it inside LATE after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To find something is to pinpoint where it is, a plain verb synonym.

clue.text: Ranger managed to arrest European

indicators.note: to arrest is to hold, so the words Ranger managed hold the answer inside them

explanation.surface: A park ranger succeeds in detaining a visitor from the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to arrest' signals letters held across 'Ranger managed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Germany is one nationality among the many peoples of Europe.

clue.text: Top salesman, hardly needed to shift this?

definitions.meaning: the rep who sells more than anyone else
a hugely popular book needs little effort to move off the shelves; shift means sell

explanation.surface: A star salesman who barely needs to try to move his stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shift' is trade slang for sell, so the second half describes a book that sells itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both the top seller of a team and a book that tops the sales charts.

clue.text: Character of those whose energy is raised right up

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a letter right up takes it to the very top of the word

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A comment on the nature of people whose energy has been boosted to the maximum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is raised right up' moves the final E of THOSE to the top of this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The distinctive spirit or character of a group or culture is its guiding set of values.

clue.text: From nightspot, ejects black cats

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
the ounce is another name for the snow leopard, a big cat

explanation.surface: A nightclub throwing out some black cats.
explanation.walkthrough: The ounce is the snow leopard, a crossword favourite for 'cat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorman who throws troublemakers out of a club is doing exactly what a club's heavy does.

clue.text: Last drink cheers

parts.note: the one in last place is at the bottom
to sup is to drink in sips

explanation.surface: Raising a final glass with a toast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last drink' reads as one phrase, but splits into the two pieces of a charade.
explanation.definitionFit: Both expressions are drinking toasts said as glasses are raised.

clue.text: Some fanciful name for part of the arm

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone choosing a whimsical label for a bit of the arm.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'for' in the definition; it is only a link word, since 'for part of the arm' cannot stand in for a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the two long bones of the forearm, alongside the radius.

clue.text: Negligent, not having transport round Spain

indicators.note: the transport-free word goes round the letter for Spain

parts.note: someone with no car is carless
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: Accusing someone of neglect for travelling round Spain without a car.
explanation.walkthrough: E is the international vehicle registration code for Spain, from España.
explanation.definitionFit: Negligent behaviour shows a lack of proper attention, the same idea as being heedless.

clue.text: Authority contains uprising

indicators.note: an uprising is a revolt, so the letters of contains are thrown into turmoil

explanation.surface: The powers that be manage to keep a rebellion in check.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' looks like a reversal sign in a down clue, but it signals an anagram of CONTAINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Official permission or approval is authority granted for an action.

clue.text: Troops in a body, almost

indicators.note: the word for a body is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a dead body is a corpse

explanation.surface: Soldiers gathered together as a single unit, or nearly so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last E of CORPSE; 'in a body' looks like an idiom meaning all together.
explanation.definitionFit: A military unit made up of troops, such as an army formation, is this word.

clue.text: Policy for Twenty20 accident?

definitions.meaning: Twenty20 is a short, fast format of cricket where batters swing hard and run quickly
a road collision where the driver flees the scene

explanation.surface: Asking what approach suits short-form cricket, and whether it ends in mishap.
explanation.walkthrough: Twenty20 is the twenty-overs-a-side form of cricket, where aggressive batting is the norm.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a batting approach of striking and dashing and a crash where the driver drives off.

clue.text: Electronic device starts iron working

indicators.note: working means being worked on, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Instructions for a gadget that starts up an electric iron.
explanation.definitionFit: This semiconductor component amplifies or switches signals in electronic circuits.

clue.text: Left good books in pile for auction

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a collection of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a stack of fine books to be sold off.
explanation.definitionFit: An item or bundle of items offered at a sale room is numbered and called by this name.

clue.text: Fairy that's mischievous: clean her up

indicators.note: mischievous means playing tricks, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A naughty sprite is told to tidy someone up.
explanation.definitionFit: This little Irish sprite of folklore guards a crock of gold, a kind of fairy.

clue.text: Everything ready to forge glossy metals

indicators.note: to forge metal is to hammer it into a new shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A smith announces he is prepared to work some shiny metals.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase, from rocket launches, declares that every part is prepared for the start.

clue.text: So swivel round when speaking for a glass of this?

indicators.note: signals that the words are to be heard said aloud rather than spelt

parts.note: taken as written; to swivel round is to turn, here in the form turns

explanation.surface: Someone turning around while offering a glass of sweet wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when speaking' tells you to say SO TURNS out loud, which sounds like the French wine name.
explanation.definitionFit: This sweet white Bordeaux is a dessert wine served in a glass, so 'this' points to the drink.

clue.text: Token of success for heavy metal band?

definitions.meaning: an award presented to musicians for high record sales
a band or ring made of a dense precious metal, playing on the rock music genre

explanation.surface: A rock group earns a sign that it has made it big.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heavy metal band' looks like a rock group, but means a disc of a heavy metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Record companies award a framed golden record for big sales, a trophy marking success.

clue.text: Follow timepiece for two hours on duty

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
a wristwatch is a timepiece

explanation.surface: Instructions to keep an eye on the clock during a short shift.
explanation.walkthrough: On ships, the dog watches are the two short two-hour watches between 4 and 8 pm.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors split the evening into two half-length shifts at sea, each lasting two hours.

clue.text: Short of money, regularly taking stimulants?

definitions.meaning: broke, a British idiom from shoes worn down to their tops
uppers are slang for amphetamine pills, so being on them means using them habitually

explanation.surface: A broke person who habitually pops pep pills.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom comes from shoes worn through so only the uppers remain; 'uppers' is also slang for stimulant drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom means being very poor, while literally it describes being on pep pills.

clue.text: Don't take opportunity to succeed at university

parts.note: to succeed in an exam is to pass it
up means in residence at a university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: Advice not to miss a chance of doing well in higher education.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage a student is 'up' while attending university.
explanation.definitionFit: To decline or let slip a chance is a phrasal verb meaning to forgo it.

clue.text: Find position in the east

definitions.meaning: to get one's bearings or locate oneself

explanation.surface: Getting one's bearings in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to get one's bearings; as a noun it names the lands of the East.

clue.text: It is dropped on the grass

definitions.text: It is dropped on the grass

parts.words: It is dropped on the grass
parts.note: morning moisture falls in drops onto lawns, rather than something being let fall

explanation.surface: Something let fall carelessly onto the lawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropped' suggests something let go, but this moisture literally forms drops on grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Overnight condensation settles as tiny droplets on grass in the morning.

clue.text: Its carriers are poles apart

parts.note: the bearers of this enclosed seat stand at opposite ends between two long poles, not opposites in opinion

explanation.surface: The people who carry something could hardly be more different.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poles apart' is an idiom for complete opposites; here the bearers stand at either end of the carrying poles.
explanation.definitionFit: This enclosed seat of the 18th century was carried on poles by two bearers, one in front, one behind.

clue.text: Formerly, a fascist symbol broken in half

indicators.note: only the first half of the symbol's name is kept

parts.note: the hooked cross adopted by the Nazis is the swastika

explanation.surface: A Nazi emblem smashed into two pieces in the past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken in half' keeps SWAS, the first four of SWASTIKA's eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used to mean as things were before, as in a former state, so 'formerly'.

clue.text: He deserves woman's love

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
O is love, a nil score in tennis

explanation.surface: A man who has earned a lady's affection.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition echoes Dryden: 'None but the brave deserves the fair.'
explanation.definitionFit: The brave man who earns admiration and the heroine's love is the figure of legend.

clue.text: Aware when tin OK to recycle

indicators.note: recycling remakes material, so the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: Knowing when a tin can goes in the recycling bin.
explanation.definitionFit: Being informed about privileged or inside information is to be well briefed.

clue.text: Passage in a detached place

parts.note: an island is a place cut off from the mainland

explanation.surface: A corridor in a remote spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A walkway between rows of seats in a church or theatre is a passage.

clue.text: In which conspirators are getting together

definitions.text: In which conspirators are getting together

parts.words: In which conspirators are getting together
parts.note: plotters are said to be 'in' this state of secret partnership

explanation.surface: Describing a place or situation where plotters meet.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads like a place, but it is the state named in the idiom 'in league'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is used only in the phrase for colluding secretly, as plotters do together.

clue.text: Star mark for tropical resort?

definitions.meaning: a dark patch on the surface of the sun, which is a star
a holiday spot with plenty of sunshine

explanation.surface: A celebrity's mark of approval for a holiday destination.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a dark patch on the sun and also a sunny holiday place.
